features_verified: 1. Backend: _generate_suggested_fix generates suggested_fix for math mismatch items (wrong total → suggests corrected total)
2. Backend: _generate_suggested_fix generates suggested_fix for missing total (qty×price → compute total)
3. Backend: _generate_suggested_fix generates suggested_fix for missing price (total÷qty → compute price)
4. Backend: _generate_suggested_fix generates suggested_fix for missing quantity (total÷price → compute quantity)
5. Backend: _generate_suggested_fix generates suggested_fix for pack parse failure with recoverable format (e.g. 1x30LB → 1/30 LB)
6. Backend: validate_and_score_item returns suggested_fix=null for trusted items
7. Backend: POST /api/purchases returns suggested_fix on items that need review
8. Frontend: Edit dialog shows blue 'Suggested fix' box with reason text for items with suggestions
9. Frontend: Apply button applies suggested values (total/price/qty/pack_size) to the item fields and revalidates
10. Frontend: Dismiss button hides the suggestion for that item (_suggestionDismissed=true)
11. Frontend: Edit Manually button enables field editing mode (blue highlight)
12. Frontend: Ignore button marks item as reviewed (hides review status, shows Confirmed)
13. Frontend: Old items without DB suggested_fix get client-side suggestions via revalidateItem on openEdit
14. Frontend: Suggestion box does NOT appear for trusted items
15. Frontend: After applying a math suggestion, item becomes trusted if math now passes
critical_code_review_comments: _generate_suggested_fix correctly handles 4 suggestion types: math (recalculate/compute), pack (normalize format), correction (from memory), missing (fill from normalization)
Frontend revalidateItem correctly generates client-side math suggestions for old items without DB suggested_fix
Apply button correctly applies suggested field values and calls revalidateItem to recalculate subtotal/total
Dismiss button correctly sets _suggestionDismissed=true to hide suggestion box
